title: Lab - ReplicaSets
description: Scale, repair and understand the selector of a ReplicaSet.
scenario: Scale, repair and understand the selector of a ReplicaSet. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Create a ReplicaSet
tasks.instructions: Create a ReplicaSet of 3 nginx Pods labelled app=web.
tasks.solution:
kubectl create deployment tmp --image=nginx --dry-run=client -o yaml | sed 's/Deployment/ReplicaSet/' > rs.yaml  # or write it by hand
kubectl apply -f rs.yaml

tasks.title: Task 2 - Scale it
tasks.instructions: Scale the ReplicaSet to 5 without editing the file.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Delete a Pod and watch
tasks.instructions: Delete one of its Pods and confirm a replacement appears.
tasks.solution:
kubectl delete pod <one-pod>
kubectl get pods -w
tasks.verification: kubectl get pods -l app=web | wc -l  # still 5 + header
